text: Managing a team is a key skill in any workplace. Good communication is essential, so leaders should share information clearly. Delegation matters too, because giving tasks to the right people saves time and builds trust. Team members also need regular feedback so they know what they are doing well and what they can improve. Motivation keeps everyone engaged, so it helps to recognise good work and reward effort. Finally, conflict resolution is important. When disagreements happen, a good leader listens to both sides and finds a fair solution. By combining these skills, managers can build a strong and happy team.
